components.gap: Supply on the route the source variant of monotone convergence that replaces the nonnegativity hypothesis: if g_n increase to g and int g_1^- dmu < infinity, then int g_n dmu increases to int g dmu (Durrett Exercise 1.5.5, p. 28), with its expectation form E X_1^- < infinity and X_n increasing to X imply E X_n increasing to E X (Exercise 1.6.13, p. 37), each with written proof.
